source_en: The intelligence agency created a notional to conceal its covert field budget.
target_hi: गुप्तचर एजेंसी ने अपने गुप्त क्षेत्रीय बजट को छिपाने के लिए एक नोशनल बनाया।
context_note: An intelligence agency creating a countable 'notional' to conceal a covert budget fixes S6.
notes: Provisional loanword transliteration नोशनल (from research) used because no standardized Hindi noun equivalent for S6 is established.

source_en: Two notionals operated from the same coastal office during the clandestine mission.
target_hi: गुप्त अभियान के दौरान एक ही तटीय कार्यालय से दो नोशनल संचालित होते थे।
context_note: Countable plural 'two notionals' operating during a clandestine mission fixes the S6 cover-company sense.
notes: Uses provisional loanword transliteration नोशनल in direct plural; no native Hindi noun equivalent is established in opened sources.

source_en: Several notionals were maintained by the foreign desk solely for clandestine logistics.
target_hi: विदेशी डेस्क द्वारा केवल गुप्त संभारण के लिए कई नोशनल बनाए रखे गए थे।
context_note: Entities maintained solely for clandestine logistics fix the S6 espionage cover-enterprise sense.
notes: Passive voice construction using provisional transliteration नोशनल.

source_en: If a notional is exposed by local auditors, the covert unit closes its office immediately.
target_hi: यदि स्थानीय लेखापरीक्षकों द्वारा कोई नोशनल उजागर हो जाता है, तो गुप्त इकाई उसका कार्यालय तुरंत बंद कर देती है।
context_note: A covert unit shutting down an office after audit exposure fixes the S6 front-company sense.
notes: Conditional clause with passive construction; provisional loanword नोशनल retained.

source_en: Payments for the covert operation were routed through an offshore notional registered under false directors.
target_hi: गुप्त अभियान के भुगतान झूठे निदेशकों के नाम पर पंजीकृत एक विदेशी नोशनल के माध्यम से भेजे गए थे।
context_note: An offshore entity registered under false directors to route covert payments fixes S6.
notes: Advanced passive construction illustrating countable singular S6 noun.

source_en: The legitimate subsidiary handled commercial shipping; the notional, clandestine intelligence transfers.
target_hi: वैध सहायक कंपनी ने वाणिज्यिक नौवहन सँभाला; नोशनल ने गुप्त खुफिया अंतरण।
context_note: Opposition between a legitimate commercial subsidiary and clandestine intelligence transfers fixes S6.
notes: Elliptical verb phrase (handled / सँभाला omitted in the second clause).

source_en: If the station relies on a notional for covert funding, analysts monitor its bank transfers closely.
target_hi: यदि केंद्र गुप्त वित्तपोषण के लिए किसी अवधारणात्मक पर निर्भर करता है, तो विश्लेषक उसके बैंक अंतरण पर कड़ी निगरानी रखते हैं।
context_note: Covert funding and monitored bank transfers fix the S6 front-company noun sense, ruling out philosophical adjective अवधारणात्मक.
notes: Negative example: अवधारणात्मक is an S1 philosophical adjective and cannot denote a countable S6 cover company.

source_en: A newly formed notional was dismantled by counterintelligence officers after the covert leak.
target_hi: गुप्त रिसाव के बाद प्रति-खुफिया अधिकारियों द्वारा एक नव-गठित छिद्रान्वेषी को समाप्त कर दिया गया।
context_note: Counterintelligence dismantling a newly formed entity after a covert leak fixes S6, contradicting 'fault-finder'.
notes: Negative example: छिद्रान्वेषी ('fault-finding') replicates a documented Shabdkosh error and is invalid for S6.
